data.body: AC amendment: Both test_pr80_zero_synthetic_schema_errors and test_pr80_100_percent_schema_compliance must assert that runner.py exits with code 0 (not just that the findings JSON has zero parse_error entries). A non-zero exit code indicates runner.py itself detected a schema error or failure — the test should capture returncode from subprocess.run and assert returncode == 0 as the first assertion, before parsing findings JSON. This verifies the full success path including S-A/S-B/S-C's validation and correction logic. Add to each test: assert result.returncode == 0, f'runner.py exited {result.returncode}: stderr={result.stderr}'
